summary: Aris Mining filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated September 30, 2026, announcing completion of ESIA preparation for the Soto Norte gold-copper project in Santander, Colombia, and the launch of community engagement ahead of environmental license submission. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is stated. The release notes revocation of the La Baja permanent reserve and reversion of the Temporary Reserve Area expiry to March 4, 2027, easing regulatory constraints. Soto Norte holds 4.6 million ounces of gold reserves at 7.0 g/t, with a 22-year mine life and 3,500 tpd mill. This is a routine operational and permitting update, not a special situation. Watch for ESIA submission, community feedback, and environmental licensing timing as the next catalysts.
